name: Spaceship d8692b4b on 3.3.3.4.4
description: A period-4 spaceship on the elongated triangular tiling 3.3.3.4.4 (touching neighbours), 7 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 4,096 rules from B45/S34 to B4,5,8,9,10,11,12/S0,3,4,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Its live cells evolve the same way on k2-003, k2-004, k3-010, k3-013, k3-016 and k3-019, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts, and on k3-051 and k3-052. The range of rules depends on the tiling: 4,096 rules on 3.3.3.4.4, k3-013, k3-019, k3-051 and k3-052; 256 rules on k2-003, k2-004, k3-010 and k3-016. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-016 (seen 249 times); it was catalogued a second time as 388daffd, found on k3-013 (seen 198 times). Flagged as most likely already known: small (7 cells), common (seen 447 times) and wide-range (4,096 rules) on an Archimedean tiling. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
